Title: Get an item by its ID
Preconditions: An item with a known ID exists in the system
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/items/{id} with the item's ID as the path variable. 2. Verify the response contains the item's details.

Test Data: {"id": 123}
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing the item's details, including its ID, name, and status.

Title: Verify that retrieving an item by ID enforces proper authorization (insecure direct object reference)
Section: Item Management - Item Retrieval by ID
Preconditions: Two users exist in the system: User A (authorized to access item with ID 1) and User B (not authorized to access item with ID 1). Item with ID 1 exists in the system.
Steps:
1. Authenticate as User B and send a GET request to /api/items/1.
2. Authenticate as an unauthenticated user and send a GET request to /api/items/1.
3. Authenticate as User A and send a GET request to /api/items/1.
Expected Result:
1. The API responds with HTTP status 403 (Forbidden) or 404 (Not Found), and no item details are returned.
2. The API responds with HTTP status 401 (Unauthorized) or 403 (Forbidden), and no item details are returned.
3. The API responds with HTTP status 200 (OK), and the response body contains the item details for ID 1.
